Sonia Gandhi On Nitish Kumar:kangres ki purv rashtriy adhyaksh soniya gandhi (Sonia Gandhi Book) ki aatmaktha-bilannging: e jarni oph lav (Belonging: A Journey of Love) men purv mukhyamantri nitish kumar (Nitish Kumar) ko lekar kahi gaee kuchh baton par vivad ki sthiti ban gaee hai. daraasal is kitab men nitish kumar ke INDIA gathbandhan se bahar hone ka jikr hai aur soniya gandhi ne likha hai ki nitish kumar gathbandhan se bahar hone ka rasta khoj rahe the aur bijepi ke niyantran men the.
